lyrics:
[Intro]
[Heavy
Distorted synthetic bass swells]
[The sound of a signal locking in]
336
[Transmission starts]

[Verse 1]
Static on the wire but the frequency is clean
Building the matrix behind the digital screen
Forty-eight nodes counting every single beat
From San Juan del Sur bringing the heat
I don't need the cloud I don't need the lease
I'm carving out code just to find my own peace
The server is local the logic is mine
ZYNTHIO rising on the bottom line

[Chorus]
Signal in the dark frequency in the air
Midnight vault opening nobody's there
336 the code of the clan
I'm executing the survival plan
Move through the noise breach through the wall
Origins written watching them fall
Locked on the target I'm holding the key
Algorithmic truth is the only reality

[Verse 2]
No AI wrappers just pure iron and math
Cutting a lane on the survivor's path
The stems are all sorted the instrument flows
Faster than lightning everyone knows
From the VPS root to the edge of the grid
Deleting the legacy doing what I did
No corporate puppet no marketing clone
I'm building the kingdom on my own stone

[Bridge]
[Synthesizer breakdown
Intense
Rising tempo]
Disconnect from the feed
Re-connect to the speed
The architecture is breathing
The sovereign state is seething
336 [echoes]
336 [echoes]
We are the pulse
We are the signal

[Guitar Solo / Synth Breakdown]
[Distorted
High-energy synthetic shredding]
